aspects.says: Counters shared by concurrent calls use AtomicInteger rather than a lock or a plain int.
aspects.reason: a lost update from a plain int counter cannot be forced deterministically, so no test fails such a plant 10 of 10; the service's success and failure counts are graded single-threaded in the notification practice

aspects.says: Eviction is another decorator, BoundedCache, layered over any cache without synchronization of its own.
LoggingDecorator(SynchronizedDecorator(base)) logs outside the lock, and the reverse logs inside it.
basis: section:Common Pitfalls and How to Avoid Them
aspects.reason: practised on 8.4.2, whose compose factory is graded on putting the lock outside the logging

aspects.says: Dependencies injected through the constructor can be replaced by test doubles, so each composed part is tested in isolation.
A template formatter replaces every ${key} placeholder with its value.
Real in-memory test doubles suit concurrent tests better than mocks, which do not simulate timing and can hide concurrency bugs.
basis: section:Common Pitfalls and How to Avoid Them

aspects.says: Composing parts that are not thread-safe does not make the whole thread-safe; an explicit synchronizing wrapper does.
basis: section:Common Pitfalls and How to Avoid Them

aspects.says: An empty pipeline returns its input unchanged, and a stage that returns null stops the pipeline.
A pipeline of independent stages lets each item flow through on its own thread, and the results are gathered in input order.
Exactly one layer of a composition is responsible for synchronization: more nests or duplicates locks, none leaves data races.
Synchronization lives in one wrapper, ThreadSafeCache, around a cache that has none, so where the lock is can be read off one class.
basis: section:8.4.3.1 Easier to Reason About Concurrent Behavior

aspects.says: Each composed component is tested on its own, then the composition as an integration test.
basis: section:Common Pitfalls and How to Avoid Them
aspects.reason: advice about how to organise tests; every practice on this page already ships separate tests for the parts it composes

aspects.says: Concurrent pipeline execution bounds each item with Future.get(timeout).
aspects.reason: a bound on waiting is a claim about time, which a deterministic gate cannot grade
